## The Good

* The tactility is good, it’s a rounded bump
* The long pole means the bottom out feels ... crisp
* They’re relatively smooth with lube
* Very little north/south and east/west stem wobble
* I used these switches with Mill-Max sockets and found them easy to install with these switches
